properties.site-address: Land North Of The Miners Arms, Morda Bank, Morda, Shropshire
properties.notes: Part of the site is brownfield (Approx 25%) and part is greenfield (Approx 75%). | The brownfield element of the site is approximately 0.04ha, whilst the total site size is some 0.19ha. | Outline Planning Permission (12/05181/OUT) and Reserved Matters Planning Permission (15/04613/REM) related to a different site area and have since lapsed. | A subsequent Outline Planning Permission (17/05237/OUT) has been granted and an associated Reserved Matters Application (20/00576/REM) is pending decision. | The development involves the creation of 8 apartments, referencing the land split, approximately 3 of these apartments are located on the brownfield element of the site. | The site is considered deliverable. | The map shows the full extent of the site and not only the brownfield area.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
